question: In which bodily locations should the moon be meditated upon?
premises: The moon is the object of meditation
The locations include the navel and head
The moon is also present in the heart
inference: One should meditate on this moon in the navel, head, and heart
uncertainties: The exact parsing of nābhimūrdhni as a locative compound is somewhat ambiguous
plain_english: O Goddess, one should meditate on this moon in the navel, in the head, and in the heart.
